subject.title: [Feature]: Disable image optimization when images are uploaded to Slack

question: Should Slack upload fidelity be solved by honoring the existing per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` contract, by adding a Slack channel/account default, or by keeping the current optimizing upload pipeline?
rationale: The source shows a real fidelity gap, but the durable behavior changes Slack media-delivery semantics and may add config/default surface, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Honor Per-Call Fidelity
options.body: Thread the existing per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` intent through Slack `upload-file` so explicit uploads can bypass image optimization while default behavior stays unchanged.

options.title: Add Slack Default
options.body: Add a default-off Slack channel/account setting for raw upload behavior, with docs, upgrade-safe defaults, and per-call override semantics.

options.title: Keep Optimizing Pipeline
options.body: Document the current Slack upload behavior and require users to stay within existing optimized media delivery unless a narrower sponsored proposal appears.

recommendation.title: Honor Per-Call Fidelity
recommendation.body: Thread the existing per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` intent through Slack `upload-file` so explicit uploads can bypass image optimization while default behavior stays unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared media loading, Slack delivery, and config compatibility, where this history is strongest.
